papers.title: GUI-CIDER: Mid-training GUI Agents via Causal Internalization and Density-aware Exemplar Reselection
papers.abstract: Despite the rapid progress of multimodal large language models in building Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents, their real-world task completion is fundamentally bottlenecked by a lack of world knowledge about GUI operations.

papers.title: Your Agents Are Aging Too: Agent Lifespan Engineering for Deployed Systems
papers.abstract: Long-lived AI agents are increasingly deployed as persistent operational systems, yet they are still evaluated like freshly initialized models. Day-one benchmarks miss a basic systems question: how long does an agent remain reliable.

papers.title: Rethinking How to Remember: Beyond Atomic Facts in Lifelong LLM Agent Memory
papers.abstract: To enable reliable long-term interaction, LLM agents require a memory system that can faithfully store, efficiently retrieve, and deeply reason over accumulated dialogue history.

papers.title: The Fragility of Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Across Typologically Diverse Languages
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring has been proposed as a promising safety mechanism for detecting misaligned behavior in large language models. Its reliability remains largely unexplored beyond English.

papers.title: Everything at Every Scale: Scale-Invariant Diffusion with Continuous Super-Resolution
papers.abstract: Creating images from noise is image generation; reconstructing fine details from coarse inputs is super-resolution. We introduce SKILD, a Scale-invariant K-Space Image Learning Diffusion model.

papers.title: How and What to Imagine? Visual Thinking in Unified Multimodal Models for Cross-View Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract: Cross-view spatial reasoning remains a weak spot for vision-language models (VLMs): they often reason in language and lose the fine-grained geometry needed for the task.

papers.title: Models That Know How Evaluations Are Designed Score Safer
papers.abstract: The validity of AI safety evaluations depends on models behaving consistently across controlled and deployment settings. We investigate evaluation meta-knowledge defined as parametric knowledge about structural traits of evaluations.

papers.title: AgentHijack: Benchmarking Computer Use Agent Robustness to Common Environment Corruptions
papers.abstract: Autonomous computer use agents powered by MLLMs are emerging as capable assistants for complex digital workflows. We introduce AgentHijack, a benchmark to evaluate robustness under common corruptions.

papers.title: BatteryMFormer: Multi-level Learning for Battery Degradation Trajectory Forecasting
papers.abstract: Early battery degradation trajectory forecasting predicts the full-life state-of-health trajectory from early operational data. We propose BatteryMFormer, a multi-level Transformer for early BDTF.

papers.title: Don't Guess, Just Ask: Resolving Ambiguity in Referring Segmentation via Multi-turn Clarification
papers.abstract: Referring segmentation aims to segment target objects based on textual query. We propose IC-Seg, an agentic framework that proactively clarifies user intent through multi-turn conversation before segmentation.

cc_updates.body: Opus 4.8 is here with high effort /xhigh for harder tasks. Introducing dynamic workflows to orchestrate work across tens to hundreds of agents. Fast mode on Opus 4.8 available at 2x standard rate for 2.5x speed. Lean system prompt now default for all models except Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus 4.7 and earlier. /simplify now runs cleanup-only review and applies fixes. Multiple bug fixes including dangerous path blocking, $TMPDIR resolution, terminal rendering, and background session improvements.

Added skipLfs option to github/git plugin marketplace sources for faster clones. Claude Code shows notice when npm global install can't auto-update. Status line commands now receive COLUMNS and LINES environment variables. Improved agent autocomplete for dispatch input. Multiple fixes including stateful MCP server reconnection, custom API gateway authentication, subagent frontmatter MCP servers, and background session improvements on Windows and macOS.

/code-review --fix now applies review findings to working tree. Skills can set disallowed-tools in frontmatter to remove tools. Added /reload-skills command and SessionStart hook returns reloadSkills option. Added MessageDisplay hook event for transforming message text. New pluginSuggestionMarketplaces managed setting for admins. Auto mode no longer requires opt-in consent. Vim mode: / in NORMAL mode opens reverse history search.
